stories.title: Instagram cracks down on AI accounts pretending to be human
stories.simple_summary: Instagram is cracking down on fake accounts run by AI that pretend to be real people. They're also adding clearer labels so you can tell when a profile is an AI character, not a human.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Instagram or sell things there, you'll have an easier time spotting which accounts are real people and which are computers pretending to be people.

stories.title: AI-driven cyber risk is top concern for global financial stability, watchdog says
stories.simple_summary: Financial regulators are worried that AI could create new problems for banks and the economy if something goes wrong.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about banks and government officials thinking ahead — nothing you need to do right now, but it means regulators are taking AI risks seriously.

stories.title: The U.S. is building barriers around drones and robots, but China has scale to get around them
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. government is trying to block drones and robots made in China from being used here, but China makes so many that competition will just happen in other countries instead.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and government policy — it doesn't directly change what you can buy or use.

stories.title: AI’s worst disasters will arrive unannounced | Letters
stories.simple_summary: A letter warns that AI could cause serious unexpected problems that nobody sees coming until it's too late.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an opinion piece about future risks — too vague to know what it means for you without reading the full letter.

stories.title: Will anybody use AI as much as coders?
stories.simple_summary: A question about whether regular people will use AI as much as computer programmers do.
stories.why_it_matters: This is too vague to explain without reading the article — the headline alone doesn't tell us enough.

stories.title: Not Nvidia. Not AMD. This Semiconductor Giant Will Be the Ultimate Winner of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Hardware Race.
stories.simple_summary: An investor article predicting which computer chip company will make the most money from AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people who own stocks — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Musk’s faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem
stories.simple_summary: Elon Musk wants to make power-generation turbines faster using a new factory, but using gas turbines creates pollution and is causing legal problems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about company decisions and energy policy — not something that directly affects your daily life or small business.

stories.title: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
stories.simple_summary: Texas Governor Abbott stopped spending taxpayer money on AI security cameras made by a company called Flock after people complained about too much surveillance. The state had already spent $30 million on them.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in Texas, your tax money won't keep going toward these cameras — but this is mainly a local government decision about surveillance concerns.

stories.title: Caterpillar is bringing to AI deployment what it learned from automating mining
stories.simple_summary: Caterpillar (the heavy equipment company) is using what it learned from automating mines to help deploy AI in other places.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to large businesses and investors — nothing you need to know unless you work in heavy equipment or mining.

stories.title: Why investors should be concerned about the growing backlash to AI data centers
stories.simple_summary: Investors are getting nervous because more people are pushing back against huge AI data centers being built in their communities.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to stock investors — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Warren Buffett's Successor, Greg Abel, Keeps Buying This Incredible Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock That Buffett Also Loved
stories.simple_summary: An investor article about Warren Buffett's successor buying stock in an AI company that Buffett also liked.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about stock picking — only relevant if you invest in the stock market.

stories.title: Help Wanted: ‘Forward-Deployed’ Humans for the A.I. Era
stories.simple_summary: Companies are hiring people to work alongside AI systems and help guide how AI is used on real projects.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're looking for work, there are new job opportunities helping companies use AI properly — but it's a new field so the jobs may require learning new skills.
